<!-- title: v0.64.0 — Room Correction: measure your room, fix your bass -->

## Highlights

- **Room Correction.** Measure your speakers where you sit, using a microphone. iQualize plays a sine sweep, averages up to five listening positions, and fits an EQ that tames booming room modes and broad dips. Measurement-mic calibration files are supported, and a level check comes first. The correction runs as its own layer under every preset and follows the output it was measured on, so switching from Flat to Bass Boost keeps the room corrected. Open it from Measure Room… in the menu bar or the EQ window's footer.
- **A correction per speaker.** Measure the left and right speakers separately when they sit differently in the room, and each gets its own correction, in Linked or split L/R mode. The Correct step also tells you when one speaker plays louder at your seat.
- **Made for small speakers.** Bookshelf and desktop speakers can't play the deepest bass, so iQualize detects where yours roll off, or you set the limit yourself from 25 to 200 Hz. The correction never boosts below that limit, and an optional high-pass keeps that bass away from small woofers.
- **Your call on the fit.** Tune the target (bass lift, treble tilt), the range, Max Q up to 30 for narrow room modes, boost up to +12 dB, and cut down to −30 dB. A live graph shows the measured, target, correction, and predicted curves. You can also save the result as an ordinary preset.
- **Rename presets** from the EQ window: Rename… in the preset sidebar's right-click menu and in the Save menu, built-in presets included.
- **Easier band editing.** Remove a band with the × on its readout. Clear every 0 dB band at once with Remove Unused Bands. New bands start at 0 dB, so adding one never changes the sound. Preset sidebar groups collapse, and presets can be deleted from the sidebar.
- **Fixes.** Bypass is now a true passthrough for presets with more than 31 bands. Changing a band from Shelf to Bell keeps its bandwidth. Band edits in split L/R mode apply to the channel you're viewing.
